watchOrderBook.description: watch the order book, every frame is a full snapshot

watchOHLCV.description: watch hourly candles, frames carry the candles touched by fresh trades

watchTrades.description: watch public trades, both sides, hand-authored frames following the asyncapi trade schema since no public trade printed during the capture window
watch public trades with the array-shaped data field described by the asyncapi spec, hand-authored

watchTickers.description: watch all tickers, the all-instruments channel fans out one frame per instrument

unWatchOrderBook.description: unsubscribe the order book, the unsub ack is matched by request id and clears the cached book
unWatchOrderBook.disabledCS: the csharp base cleanUnsubscription never resolves the unsubscribe future, its final client.resolve is commented out in Exchange.BaseMethods.cs - recheck when the port catches up

unWatchTicker.disabledCS: the csharp base cleanUnsubscription never resolves the unsubscribe future, its final client.resolve is commented out in Exchange.BaseMethods.cs - recheck when the port catches up

unWatchTrades.disabledCS: the csharp base cleanUnsubscription never resolves the unsubscribe future, its final client.resolve is commented out in Exchange.BaseMethods.cs - recheck when the port catches up

unWatchOHLCV.description: unsubscribe the candle stream, exercises the per-timeframe cache cleanup branch
unWatchOHLCV.disabledCS: the csharp base cleanUnsubscription never resolves the unsubscribe future, its final client.resolve is commented out in Exchange.BaseMethods.cs - recheck when the port catches up

watchOrders.description: watch the orders channel, the frame carries one short-form order object

watchMyTrades.description: watch the fills channel, the data field is an array of short-form fill objects

watchPositions.description: watch the portfolio channel, every frame is a full snapshot with long field names plus the adl index

watchBalance.description: watch the margin summary through the portfolio channel
